notes.title: Development Log #2
notes.content: [p]Hello![/p][p]This is [b]ROCOCO GAMES[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This time, we're sharing development progress on the field areas for "[b]The Perfect Prince[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]Originally, we designed this title as a story-driven adventure with minimal action elements.[/p][p]However, we faced the challenge that having the playable character just walk made the gameplay feel monotonous... 💦[/p][p][/p][p]Of course, that wasn't the only factor contributing to the monotonous feel, but driven purely by the instinct to make the character move more! we partially revised the level design and implemented “Jumping” and “Climbing/Descending Ladders”!![/p][p][/p][p]Jumping[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/d627f59013f822a7803f9699c8791d7fd5850621.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ladders[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/d97781188161dfbe38fdeba36fd7d36515fc1721.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The core design philosophy itself remains unchanged (it doesn't require that much interactivity), so it's really just a minor sensory enhancement for atmosphere. But honestly, having more elements that react to you definitely makes you feel more connected to the protagonist!![/p][p][/p][p]Glad I did it. Yeah (self-satisfied).[/p][p][/p][p]※I also tested pushing and pulling objects, but design-wise, the gimmick felt a bit too much and the annoyance outweighed the fun, so I decided to hold off on implementing that for now 🤔[/p][p][/p][p]Since we're at it, here's the latest, beautiful background that isn't a GIF.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/f44cdea0a7752cc4796d9713366cec4c2ea1bae1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/279fa7411d89378dcef52b9fa08826757ddec66b.png"][/img][/p][p]That's all for this time.[/p][p]Please continue to support [b]ROCOCO GAMES[/b] and “[b]The Perfect Prince[/b]”![/p][p]Bonus 4-panel comic.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/7f82a277b10e4e269ca0937ff27187b754571907.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/805ce3b07d8524e95b941d6f93221e50c85a7016.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Log #1
notes.content: [p]Nice to meet you.[/p][p]We are [b]ROCOCO GAMES[/b]![/p][p]It's been a month and a half since we opened the store page for “[b]The Perfect Prince[/b]”...[/p][p]Finally, we have created the key art and logo![/p][p][/p][p]The title screen of the build under development is also reflected immediately ↓ [/p][p]*Japanese version only[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/efaf2a90fa937346ff9c0eb1e8b3138df880370a.png"][/img][/p][p]The atmosphere is now much more pleasant![/p][p][/p][p]We hope to keep you updated on our progress and worldview in this irregular development journal.[/p][p]We look forward to your continued support of [b]ROCOCO GAMES[/b] and “[b]The Perfect Prince[/b]”![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/bbfd05bc291885acfd1e16ba9cef8fee3c33b14a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681529/26269a3513de0c507104de1c234eae725b7ab13f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Under production![/p]
